scope_note: Update channels let the assistant check current CE-RISE repository, release, tag, repository-discovery, documentation, and generated-artifact metadata at tool-call time. Stable guidance remains catalog-driven; current version-sensitive facts should be resolved from these channels when requested.

policy.network_scope: Only configured read-only HTTP(S) channels are checked.
policy.interpretation_rule: Remote metadata can update recommendations about versions, recently changed components, and documentation pointers, but it must not override the stable non-substitution scope rule.
